metric_definitions.accuracy: Proportion of total predictions that exactly match ground truth.
metric_definitions.top_1_accuracy: Proportion where the highest-probability class matches ground truth (equivalent to accuracy in single-label classification).
metric_definitions.macro_averaging: Unweighted mean across all classes; treats every class equally regardless of sample frequency.
metric_definitions.weighted_averaging: Support-weighted mean across classes; reflects empirical class frequency distribution.
